assertions.subject: kirk
assertions.object: Research personnel on alien planets require annual medical certification by a starship surgeon.
assertions.counter_evidence_search: None in this single derivative edition refutes the fact that Kirk made the claim.
assertions.falsifier: An authenticated source could establish the rule is misquoted or source representation differs; in-work policy's legal force remains unverified.

assertions.subject: tos-man-trap-candidate-20261102
assertions.object: Different landing-party members apparently perceive different faces associated with the Nancy encounter.
assertions.counter_evidence_search: No direct counter to the narration within the read page.
assertions.falsifier: An authenticated audiovisual cut might distinguish actual staging from text gloss, performance and editing.

assertions.subject: tos-man-trap-candidate-20261102
assertions.object: A plant-poison explanation appears in NANCY-labeled and Crater speaker turns; later officers report contrary medical and botanical findings.
assertions.counter_evidence_search: Medical lines contest the causal account, not the record that parties disagreed.
assertions.falsifier: A distinct edition might show a physical event not present in the text, changing which accounts are supported.

assertions.subject: mccoy
assertions.object: Examination found an unexplained absence of sodium chloride in Darnell's body.
assertions.counter_evidence_search: No independent specimen, instrument trace or conflicting numerical report appears in the text.
assertions.falsifier: An authenticated independent medical record, scene or source edition might contradict the reported test.

assertions.subject: crater
assertions.object: A creature killed the historical Nancy, who Crater says is buried locally; he cannot firmly date the death beyond roughly one or two years.
assertions.counter_evidence_search: No independent death witness or burial record is depicted in the read text.
assertions.falsifier: Independent evidence of Nancy's death, its cause, burial or chronology could establish or refute each component separately.

assertions.subject: tos-man-trap-candidate-20261102
assertions.object: Attributed Crater and MCCOY-labeled speaker turns argue for protecting or feeding the creature, while Kirk's turns emphasize reported crew deaths; a later Kirk speaker turn invokes the buffalo.
assertions.counter_evidence_search: The derivative text supplies competing speaker positions; it supplies no independent narrator's verdict on survival rights or crew security.
assertions.falsifier: A better-authenticated cut could alter which deaths, threats or nonlethal options are presented.

assertions.subject: tos-man-trap-candidate-20261102
assertions.object: Crew members raise questions about correspondence between a missing Green and Green-labeled sightings, and between familiar appearances and uncertain speaker identity.
assertions.counter_evidence_search: The text contains several competing indications about identity but no stable identity-authentication mechanism.
assertions.falsifier: Primary AV shot continuity, speech or independently authenticated crew logs could resolve specific appearance occurrences.

assertions.subject: tos-man-trap-candidate-20261102
assertions.object: A McCoy-labeled speaker refuses to shoot the apparent Nancy and later verbally rejects that identification; the transcript supplies final pleas but no explicit action stage direction.
assertions.counter_evidence_search: No explicit stage direction in the derivative authenticates exactly how the final weapon is fired.
assertions.falsifier: A primary audiovisual or script witness must settle movements, facial transformations and shot sequence.

assertions.subject: crater
assertions.object: A once populous local kind has only one survivor and needs salt to live.
assertions.counter_evidence_search: No source-independent census, specimen comparison or ecological study appears in the derivative page.
assertions.falsifier: External work, source edition evidence, or specimens could independently challenge survivor count and salt requirement.
